definition_zh: 擦亮；磨光；使光洁；使更有光泽
definition_en: to polish a surface by rubbing, especially metal, until it shines
core_image: 布团在铜壶上转圈擦拭，映出人影
scene: 旅馆前台，老服务员把铜门把手擦得能照出笑脸。The valet burnished the brass rail until it gleamed.
sceneCN: 这里 burnish 是「擦亮、抛光」（第 1 个义项：摩擦使金属发亮）；句意是侍者把铜栏杆擦得闪闪发光。

derivatives.zh: 由过去分词转形容词，义为「擦亮的，光洁的」
由动词加 -er 构成，义为「抛光器，磨光工具」

senses.title: To polish by rubbing
senses.definition: to make a surface smooth and shiny by friction, especially metal
senses.definitionCN: 以摩擦使表面平滑发亮，多用于金属
senses.example: She burnished the old candlesticks with a soft cloth.
senses.exampleCN: 她用软布把旧烛台擦得锃亮。
senses.why: The French root means brown; rubbing brings out the deep glow of metal.
senses.whyCN: 法语词根本义「褐色」，摩擦让金属透出深沉的光泽。

senses.title: The sheen produced by polishing
senses.definition: the smooth shine that polished metal or wood displays
senses.definitionCN: 打磨后的金属或木头呈现的光亮
senses.example: The table kept a warm burnish from years of hands.
senses.exampleCN: 经年累月的摩挲给桌子留下温润的光泽。
senses.why: The act names its visible result.
senses.whyCN: 动作转指其可见成果，擦亮即亮。

senses.title: To improve a reputation or image
senses.definition: to make a reputation, image or record look better
senses.definitionCN: 使声誉、形象或履历更显光彩
senses.example: The charity work burnished the company's image.
senses.exampleCN: 慈善活动为公司形象添了彩。
senses.why: Metal shine becomes figurative luster on a public face.
senses.whyCN: 金属之光转为公众形象的光彩，义项移入比喻。

intro.en: Burnish came from Old French brunir, to make brown, from brun, brown.
intro.cn: burnish 源自古法语 brunir（使成褐色），词根 brun 意为褐色。

items.en: a reconstructed root reudh-bher- may lie behind words for shining brown.
items.cn: 一般重构词根与「发亮的褐色」相关，来源存有争议。

items.en: brun meant brown; brunir meant to make brown or gleam.
items.cn: 古法语 brun 指褐色，brunir 指使成褐色或发亮。

items.en: burnishen entered Middle English through legal and craft texts.
items.cn: 经盎格鲁-法语 burnishen 进入中古英语，见于工艺文献。

items.en: armorers and bookbinders used burnishers to gleam steel and leather.
items.cn: 十四至十八世纪甲胄匠与装订工用磨光器处理钢铁与皮革。

items.en: burnish now also means to polish a public image.
items.cn: 如今 burnish 还可指「美化公众形象」。

note.en: Burnish carries the brun- root into English and stands by the polishing lexicon.
note.cn: burnish 把 brun- 词根带入英语，与抛光词汇为伍。

entries.definitionCN: 擦亮的，burnish 的过去分词形容词
磨光工具，burnish 的施动名词
燃烧，仅开头字母相同，词源无关
深色头发的人，同出 brun（褐）一词根

entries.definition: to give out or polish to brightness
to fit with a glossy surface

normalIntro.en: Rub until the brown gleam rises out of the metal.
normalIntro.cn: 一直擦，直到金属透出褐色的光。

normal.en: The root brun means brown, the color of old brass.
normal.cn: 词根 brun 意为褐色，正是旧黄铜的颜色。

normal.en: The -ish ending is the French -ir verb ending in disguise.
normal.cn: -ish 词尾其实是法语动词 -ir 的变体。

normal.en: Burnish one's image is the common figurative use.
normal.cn: burnish one's image 是常见的比喻用法。

normal.en: A burnisher is the flat tool bookbinders rub with.
normal.cn: burnisher 是装订工用的磨光工具。

normal.en: Burnish and burn have no family tie.
normal.cn: burnish 与 burn 并无词源亲缘。

abstract.en: Feel the cloth grow warm as the brass brightens.
abstract.cn: 感受铜器变亮时布团的温热。

abstract.en: See your face wobble in the polished kettle.
abstract.cn: 看见自己的笑脸在擦亮的铜壶上晃动。

abstract.en: Hear the squeak of leather under a rubbing stone.
abstract.cn: 听磨石下皮革被蹭出的吱吱声。

examples.en: He burnished the shield until it mirrored the sun.
examples.cn: 他把盾牌擦得能映出太阳。

examples.en: The trial burnished her reputation for courage.
examples.cn: 这场审判为她平添了勇敢的美名。

examples.en: Old oak banquets keep their burnish from a century of sleeves.
examples.cn: 老橡木餐台留着百年衣袖磨出的光泽。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不如你洗」——铜壶脏了，「不如你」亲手「洗」一擦，立刻锃亮。

root: burnish 经盎格鲁-法语源自古法语 brunir「使成褐色、使发亮」，词根 brun「褐色」在英语中留下 brunette、brunet 等同族词；动词义「摩擦发亮」即由「透出褐色光泽」而来，无日耳曼词根。

sensesIntro.en: Rubbing brown metal into shine first names the act, then the sheen, and finally the polish put on a public image.
sensesIntro.cn: 把褐色金属擦出光，先指动作，再指光泽，最后落在给形象「抛光」的比喻上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cloth circling brass until a face appears in it.
core.cn: 核心意象：布团在黄铜上打转，直到映出人影。

intro.en: Burnish keeps the French verb ending -ir as English -ish, like finish and punish.
intro.cn: burnish 把法语动词尾 -ir 变作英语 -ish，与 finish、punish 同例。

latinIntro.en: The root brun is Germanic in origin but reached English through French.
latinIntro.cn: 词根 brun 本出日耳曼语，却经法语进入英语。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 抛光，润饰（polish 与 polish 的名词义之源）
